outcomeNote: A single homiletic statement on the verse with its prooftext

segments.he: ״וַיָּקָם דָּוִד וַיִּכְרֹת אֶת כְּנַף הַמְּעִיל אֲשֶׁר לְשָׁאוּל בַּלָּט״, אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בְּרַבִּי חֲנִינָא: כׇּל הַמְבַזֶּה אֶת הַבְּגָדִים, סוֹף אֵינוֹ נֶהֱנֶה מֵהֶם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְהַמֶּלֶךְ דָּוִד זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַיְכַסֻּהוּ בַּבְּגָדִים וְלֹא יִחַם לוֹ״.
segments.en: The Gemara continues with a homiletic interpretation of the verse: «“Then David arose, and cut off the corner of Saul’s robe privily”» (I Samuel 24:4). «Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Ḥanina, said: Anyone who treats clothing with contempt,» like David who tore Saul’s robe for no reason, will be punished in that «ultimately he will not benefit from» his garments, «as it is stated: “Now King David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he could get no heat”» (I Kings 1:1).
